limitations: approx_input_tokens is an estimate of how much a tool result added to the next model input; it is not billed usage and must not be added to model-level input/output/cache totals.
environment_id and profile_id are injected by the adapter because the telemetry carries only host-level resource attributes.

Parallel and batch segments split their measured input increase using per-result token counts from the token-count API (attribution_method=parallel-token-count / batch-token-count): each result first gets a fixed per-result overhead k, the rest is split in proportion to the counts, and the split preserves the segment total.
Per-result overhead k for claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 is 16 tokens: the median of (measured increase - counted tokens) over 3 sequential segment(s) in this data.
inventory_snapshot_id is null: no InventorySnapshot was provided, so every record is unmatched.
pricing.source=reference_list_price uses public list prices for reference because the configured price is zero or missing; it is not the actual bill.
A run cut off at the end of the capture can leave its last tools unattributed; re-run the adapter on a later capture that contains the whole run.
